notes.title: In game desktop
notes.notes: Under the tools tab you will find the desktop. It can be used as a video player which you can add mp4 formatted videos to watch, or it can be used to access your PC's desktop while in Your World. They can be resized to any size you choose and placed anywhere.

notes.title: Tutorial Level
notes.notes:
Tutorial  level added with audio and video instructions to help with building tools and objects. 

Changes to the NPC builder to make building a companion much easier.

Changes to  the transform cube to make it easier and reusable.

Cube of navigation now makes objects unable to be grabbed as well as adding objects to the terrain data to skip having to do both.

notes.title: Paint Update
notes.notes: Big painting update. There is now a drawing tool and a paint-gun to use to paint just about every object in game.
